status_legend.needs review: Published here and does not block the release. A human should read it before buying.
status_legend.blocking: Would prevent publishing a value. There are no blocking items: unverified values were left blank instead.

items.title: "Solid" is not stated on 50 of 71 listings
items.affected: 50 of 71 rows (every listing without the word solid): rs-571221, rs-571222, rs-571223, rs-571213, rs-981367, rs-907250, rs-960952, rs-879968, rs-999230, rs-991907, rs-993512, rs-991908, rs-864785, rs-943668, rs-242556, rs-254575, rs-240912, wc-tulip, wc-4prong, wc-4prong-petite, wc-6prong, wc-gerbera, as-bea-sol, as-hazeline, as-bea-3stone, au-2ct-oval, au-1ct-emerald, au-3ct-round, au-cigar, bn-14k-ccf-203284, bn-14k-tc-203288, bn-14k-leaf-192442, bn-14k-bezel-296643, bn-14k-ridge-304497, bn-14k-6p-203272, bn-18k-6p-194159, bn-18k-pn-203268, be-18k-6p-121h6, rs-939479, car-18k-etincelle-pear, car-18k-etincelle-emerald, car-18k-1895-band-dia, mene-24k-classic-band, mene-24k-narrow-band, rs-222283, rs-989853, rs-997441, rs-255232, car-18k-destinee-princess, bn-14k-petite-195639
items.finding: Across the integrated 71-row dataset (11 retailers), 21 listings explicitly include the word "solid" in the seller's own text (8 Automic Gold, 7 Mejuri, 4 Auvere 22K, Ross-Simons 997811, and Aurate Diamond X Ring), while 50 state a karat mark or 750/1000 fineness without the word "solid". Under FTC 16 CFR § 23.3(c)(1), "Solid Gold" legally requires non-hollow construction.
items.buyer_action: Before paying, get the seller to confirm in writing: "solid 14K gold, not plated, not vermeil, not gold-filled, not gold over silver". Keep that message with the receipt.

items.title: Metal weight is unpublished on 46 of 71 listings (25 publish grams)
items.affected: 46 of 71 rows (no published gram weight): rs-879968, rs-999230, rs-991907, rs-993512, rs-991908, rs-864785, rs-943668, rs-242556, rs-254575, rs-240912, wc-tulip, wc-4prong, wc-4prong-petite, wc-6prong, wc-gerbera, as-bea-sol, as-hazeline, as-bea-3stone, bn-14k-ccf-203284, bn-14k-tc-203288, bn-14k-leaf-192442, bn-14k-bezel-296643, bn-14k-ridge-304497, bn-14k-6p-203272, bn-18k-6p-194159, bn-18k-pn-203268, mej-deb, mej-db, mej-bde, mej-2mm, be-18k-6p-121h6, mej-10k-dlr, mej-10k-sig, car-18k-etincelle-pear, car-18k-etincelle-emerald, car-18k-1895-band-dia, mene-24k-classic-band, mene-24k-narrow-band, auv-22k-vneck-sm, auv-22k-hexagon-diamond, auv-22k-diamond-bridge-tall, auv-22k-clean-cut-polished, rs-255232, car-18k-destinee-princess, bn-14k-petite-195639, mej-14k-sdeb
items.finding: Across all 11 retailers, 25 of 71 listings publish an explicit gram weight (12 Ross-Simons, 8 Automic Gold, and 5 Aurate — spanning 0.3 g to 7.0 g across 10K, 14K, and 18K). The remaining 46 rows publish no unambiguous gram figure in static HTML (including 4 Auvere 22K rings whose size-range "Approximate Fine Weight" basis is ambiguous and kept null per Flag F54, 2 JS-rendered Menē 24K bands, and withdrawn SKU rs-939479), so their weight stays blank rather than guessed.
items.buyer_action: For a listing with no published weight, ask the seller for the grams of your exact size in writing and run the calculator with it. For the seven that do publish a weight, treat the figure as the seller's claim until an independent jeweller weighs the ring.

items.title: Aurate mixes vermeil and solid gold inside one listing
items.finding: The Modern Cigar Band feed reports price_min 118.00 and price_max 1668.00. 118.00 is the vermeil variant; the 14K variant is 1,308.00. A shopper who sorts by lowest price sees a vermeil price for a solid-gold product page.
items.buyer_action: Always switch the metal selector to 14K or 18K and re-read the price before adding to cart.

items.title: With Clarity prices are for the setting only
items.finding: These products carry the tag "Ring Setting Product". The listed range buys the metal setting; the centre diamond is a separate purchase. The total cost of a finished ring is therefore higher than the number shown.
items.buyer_action: Build the full ring (setting + stone) and compare the total, not the setting price.

items.title: Ross-Simons also sells a setting with the stone excluded
items.finding: The listing text states "Center stone and setting are sold separately." and the product is tagged SEMIMOUNTING, so the price — a single $1,269.00 clearance price as of pass P12, with a stated original of $1,795.00 — does not buy a complete ring. Sizes 5, 6 and 6.5 were sold out on the re-read.
items.buyer_action: Read the word "setting" carefully and budget separately for the centre stone. Ask which sizes are actually in stock before you plan a resize.

items.title: Two very low solid-gold prices — now testable against published weights
items.finding: $149 for a 14K ring and $179 for an 18K ring looked implausible. Pass P12 found both pages publish a metal weight: 0.5 grams each. At 14K that is about 0.29 g of fine gold; at 18K about 0.375 g. The prices are therefore consistent with extremely light rings, not with a mis-stated karat. The earlier finding said the value could not be checked; it now can, and the answer is "thin and light", not "fake".
items.buyer_action: Decide whether 0.5 g of metal is enough ring for daily wear. Weigh it on arrival - an independent jeweller can do this in a minute - and treat any shortfall from the stated 0.5 g as a return reason.

items.title: Estate pieces are one-of-a-kind and fixed size
items.finding: All three Ross-Simons estate listings are single-size, one-of-a-kind pieces. Ross-Simons' published policy refuses returns on merchandise 'altered, or resized by a jeweler other than Ross-Simons', so resizing can end your return right. The policy page retrieved does not publish a separate estate-jewellery carve-out either way, so estate-specific terms remain unconfirmed.
items.buyer_action: Buy your exact size, or have the retailer resize it. Get the return position in writing before ordering.

items.title: With Clarity Gerbera: is the sapphire included?
items.finding: The product is tagged "Ring Setting Product" (which normally means stone excluded) yet the description presents the marquise created sapphire as part of the ring. The listing does not resolve the contradiction.
items.buyer_action: Ask customer service, in writing, whether 1,210.00 includes the created sapphire centre stone.

items.title: Anna Sheffield price range is not explained line by line
items.finding: Bea Three Stone is listed 5,400.00-25,100.00 and Hazeline 7,150.00-9,200.00. The listings mention stone sizes but do not map each price to a specific configuration.
items.buyer_action: Ask for a written quote for the exact stone you are buying before paying.

items.title: No phone or support address verified for With Clarity
items.finding: Contact details were confirmed from official pages for Ross-Simons (phone 800-835-0919 and a support email), Aurate (support email) and Anna Sheffield (info@annasheffield.com). For With Clarity only official store metadata (Long Island City, NY, USD, ship-to countries) was confirmed; no phone number or support address was verified in this pass.
items.buyer_action: Find a phone number or postal address on With Clarity's own site and test it before ordering.

items.title: Return windows are short and returns are not free everywhere
items.finding: Anna Sheffield allows two weeks from delivery and charges a 10% restocking fee (capped at $500) on refunds. With Clarity allows 30 days but charges $250 if the diamond certificate is missing and $300 to re-certify. With Clarity also refuses returns on jewellery 'worked on, resized or repaired by another jeweler', and Anna Sheffield makes engraved or bespoke orders final sale. A return is therefore not automatically free or unlimited.
items.buyer_action: Decide within the window, keep every certificate and the original box, do not resize before you commit, and photograph the ring the day it arrives.

items.title: A hallmark and maker’s mark cannot be verified online
items.finding: No retailer page retrieved — in this pass or the first one — states the exact hallmark or maker’s mark that will be struck inside the band. A photograph of the inside of the band is the only pre-purchase evidence, and it still does not prove purity. US marking rules are set out in 16 CFR Part 23, including § 23.3 on misrepresentation of gold content and § 23.10 on quality marks.
items.buyer_action: Ask for a close-up photo of the stamp. On arrival, have an independent jeweller confirm the stamp and test purity (XRF preferred).

items.title: Aurate metal-variant prices are not mapped one-to-one
items.finding: For these three rings the feed reports only a min/max across 14K, 18K, platinum and ring sizes. The lowest price is not proven to be the 14K price, so the low end is shown as a range rather than as a 14K price. Addendum (sess-67748540, P116, 2026-10-23T23:39Z): the seller's own variant feed does map every metal to a price for all three SKUs — 14k yellow/white is the low end (au-1ct-emerald $1,498; au-2ct-oval $1,968; au-3ct-round $2,438), 18k is $1,878 / $2,438 / $2,858, and the stored high end is the Platinum variant ($2,100 / $2,800 / $3,000). The flag stands because the HTML page still prints no per-metal price without scripting, and because a $2,800 high end is not a 14K price.
items.buyer_action: Set metal to 14K and the size you need, then read the actual price before buying.

items.title: Carat weight is not the same as metal weight
items.finding: Listings quote ct. t.w. (total carat weight of stones). That says nothing about how many grams of gold you are buying, which is what the gold-value comparison needs. 16 CFR 23.18 covers misrepresentation of weight and "total weight".
items.buyer_action: Ask separately for the gold weight in grams. Keep stone weight and metal weight in separate columns, as this site does.

items.title: Blue Nile 18K ring description contradicts its own metal specification
items.finding: The Petite Nouveau Six-Prong Solitaire page is titled and specified as 18K Yellow Gold, but the product description on the same page says the ring is “crafted in polished 14k white gold”. One of the two statements is wrong. Do not buy without written confirmation of the metal from the seller.
items.buyer_action: Ask Blue Nile, in writing, which metal the 18K ring is and get it on the receipt. Photograph the stamp on arrival.

items.title: Search-engine snippet price ($925) does not match the live page ($1,420)
items.finding: A search result for Blue Nile item 203268 displayed “$925 (Setting Price)”. The live page read $1,420 on 2026-10-22. The live page is authoritative and is what this dataset records. This is why snippets are never used as price evidence in this project.
items.buyer_action: Never trust a search-result price. Open the live page and use that number, as this site does.

items.title: Mejuri Bold Diamond Eternity Ring: snippet $2,800 vs live $2,900
items.finding: A search snippet showed $2,800; the live page on the 14k white gold / natural diamond selection showed “From $2,900”. Mejuri prices vary by material, stone and size, and “From” prices move with size. The dataset records the material- and date-stamped value.
items.buyer_action: Set the exact metal, stone and size, then read the price. "From" prices are not purchase prices.

items.title: First pass: no listing published a ring's weight in grams (0 of 13)
items.finding: Historical finding from the first research pass over Blue Nile, Mejuri and Brilliant Earth: none of those 13 listings published a gram weight — pages gave width and thickness instead. It still holds for those 13 rows. Later passes did recover weights from Ross-Simons and Aurate, so the whole-dataset count is now 7 of 43 (F02). This entry is kept so the earlier claim is not silently rewritten.
items.buyer_action: Ask for the gram weight before paying, in writing. A jeweller can weigh it in seconds on arrival.

items.title: No listing publishes hallmark or maker's mark details (0 of 13 checked, still true for the rest)
items.finding: None of the pages reviewed state what is stamped inside the band. Under the National Stamping Act a quality mark must be accompanied by the maker's trademark, so the absence of published hallmark information is a legitimate pre-purchase question, not proof of a problem. Verify the stamp in person and with XRF after delivery.
items.buyer_action: Ask for a close-up photo of the inside of the band and have an independent jeweller read the stamp.

items.title: Setting-only prices are not ring prices (9 of 13 rows)
items.finding: Blue Nile and Brilliant Earth quote “Setting Price” / “Setting Only”, which excludes the centre diamond. A $1,000 setting plus a diamond is a materially different purchase. Mejuri's 4 rows are complete-ring prices, so the two groups must never be compared directly.
items.buyer_action: Budget for the centre stone separately; compare finished-ring totals, not setting prices.

items.title: “From” prices on Mejuri change with ring size
items.finding: Two Mejuri rows show “From $…”, meaning the selected size determines the final price. The recorded number is the lowest displayed price on the date checked.
items.buyer_action: Never budget from a "from" price. Configure the ring and re-read the total.

items.title: Blue Nile return window starts at shipment (not delivery) and caps free returns at 2/year
items.finding: First pass noted the PDP did not state the return window. Direct read of Blue Nile's official Returns Policy (bluenile.com/policies/returns) on 2026-10-22 confirmed 30 days from the shipment date (shorter than delivery-based windows), maximum 2 complimentary US returns per customer per year, $150 fee for a missing diamond certificate, and complete exclusion of resized or custom-designed rings.
items.buyer_action: Get the return window and any resize exclusion in writing before ordering.

items.title: Brilliant Earth 30-day return clock starts at shipment/pickup readiness and excludes resized or comparative orders
items.finding: First pass noted the PDP did not state return exclusions. Direct read of Brilliant Earth's official 30-Day Returns policy (brilliantearth.com/30-Day-Returns/) on 2026-10-22 confirmed 30 days from when the order is available for shipment/pickup, RMA valid 7 days, $40 engraving-removal fee ($250 missing certificate fee), and exclusion of resized, third-party modified, custom, or "comparative purchasing" orders.
items.buyer_action: Get the return window in writing before ordering.

items.title: Independent BBB reputation check across 11 retailers: 4 A+ Accredited, 2 A+ Unaccredited, Aurate rated F
items.finding: Better Business Bureau (bbb.org) records verified through 2026-10-23 across all 11 retailers: Ross-Simons, Blue Nile, Brilliant Earth, and With Clarity hold A+ BBB Accreditation; Anna Sheffield and Auvere LLC (0121-87168132) hold A+ unaccredited profiles; Mejuri, Automic Gold, and Cartier hold unaccredited HQ files; Menē has audited public-company disclosures (no BBB file confirmed); and Aurate New York holds an "F" rating (8 unanswered of 23 complaints; 1.22/5 customer reviews).
items.buyer_action: Search the retailer name plus "complaints" on your own, and check the business address is real.

items.title: 16 CFR Part 23 read in full — § 23.3(c)(1) bars calling hollow gold "Solid Gold"
items.finding: Earlier passes read excerpts only. On 2026-10-22, eCFR 16 CFR Part 23 (current 2026-10-21) was read in full (§ 23.1–§ 23.18), confirming § 23.3(c)(1) & fn. 32 (hollow-center karat gold cannot be called "Solid Gold"), 15 U.S.C. 295 3/7 ppt assay tolerances, § 23.4 Vermeil (≥2.5 µm ≥10K over sterling), § 23.7 rhodium disclosure, § 23.10 / 15 U.S.C. 297 mandatory trademark beside any quality mark, and § 23.18 (1 ct = 200 mg). Individual state consumer statutes remain outside scope.
items.buyer_action: Read the regulation section yourself before relying on it.

items.title: Credit-card dispute rights verified via CFPB (FCBA 60-day & home-state/100-mile rules); cardholder perks vary
items.finding: Official CFPB guidance on the Fair Credit Billing Act (15 U.S.C. § 1666 & § 1666i; Ask-CFPB en-61 & en-1969) was verified on 2026-10-22: billing errors (undelivered/unaccepted/wrong-amount goods) require written notice within 60 days of the statement; statutory quality "claims and defenses" require a good-faith merchant attempt, >$50 price, and purchase in your home state or within 100 miles of your billing address (though many card networks/issuers waive geographic limits by contract — check your own cardholder agreement). Debit, wire, and non-credit BNPL lack FCBA protection.
items.buyer_action: Pay by credit card; the protection comes from your card issuer, not from the retailer.

items.title: Spot gold is a single commercial reading, and the page disagreed with itself by $1.08
items.finding: The recorded spot ($4,026.79/oz at 2026-10-22 07:07 NY) is from a commercial aggregator, not an exchange feed. A second ticker on the same page showed $4,025.71. The calculator therefore treats spot as an editable input and stamps every result with the number used.
items.buyer_action: Take the gold price as a reference, not a quote. Two publishers can differ by a dollar.

items.title: Brilliant Earth 18K ring uses 14K white gold prongs
items.finding: The product detail lists “Prong metal: 14K White Gold” on an 18K yellow gold ring. This is a mixed-metal construction, not an error, but it means not all metal in the ring is 18K.
items.buyer_action: If the two-tone detail matters, confirm the karat of every component (band and prongs) in writing.

items.title: Retailers named during discovery that remain unvetted in canonical table (Costco, James Allen, Tiffany, Derco)
items.finding: Costco, James Allen, Tiffany & Co., and Derco Diamonds appeared during earlier discovery passes and are not included in the 59 canonical purchasable rows (note: 5 Aurate rows, 3 Cartier 18K rows, 7 Automic Gold rows, and 2 Menē 24K rows ARE vetted and included; Tiffany GRP10863 was checked on 2026-10-22 and excluded because it is currently unavailable online and non-returnable).
items.buyer_action: Vet each retailer yourself: phone number, postal address and a live support channel.

items.title: Prices moved between research passes — two rows corrected
items.finding: Re-reading the same two product pages on 2026-10-22 gave different prices from the earlier pass. rs-571223 now lists $849.00 on every in-stock size, so the stored $799.00 floor is no longer on the page. rs-943668 is now a clearance item at $1,269.00 with an original price of $1,795.00, and sizes 5, 6 and 6.5 are sold out; the stored $1,439.00 ceiling was a size variant that is no longer listed. Both rows were corrected to the price the page shows, and the old values are kept in data/reverification.json so nothing is silently overwritten.
items.buyer_action: Treat every price here as a snapshot. Open the product link on the row before you buy, and expect the other 35 rows to have moved too — they were not re-read in this pass.

items.title: Ross-Simons coverage pattern confirmed across 23 SKUs: non-stone gold bands publish Gold Weight; stone/estate rings omit it
items.finding: Across all 23 Ross-Simons SKUs (including 2026-10-23 additions 222283 3.3g, 989853 1.2g, 997441 3.4g, and 255232 estate solitaire, plus withdrawn Claddagh SKU 939479 1.5g), every stone-free gold band publishes a "Gold Weight" gram spec, whereas all 11 stone-set/estate engagement rings omit metal weight on the page.
items.buyer_action: If a Ross-Simons row matters to you, open its page and read the Gold Weight line yourself — it is usually there. Send it to me and it can be verified into the table.

items.title: Mejuri's return promise has an exclusion that matters for rings: engraving
items.affected: all Mejuri rows (mej-2mm, mej-db, mej-deb, mej-bde)
items.finding: The Mejuri product page states "We offer free 30-day returns & exchanges starting from the day the shipment is delivered or picked up in-store. Some exclusions apply" and, separately, "Engraved items are not eligible for return." Engraving is offered as an option in the same buy box as the ring, so a personalised ring can lose its return right at checkout.
items.buyer_action: Do not add engraving until you have weighed and inspected the ring, or accept that the purchase becomes final.

items.title: Seller-published weights (25 of 71 rows) are marked approximate — every melt figure inherits that tolerance
items.affected: all rows with a published weight (25 of 71): rs-571221, rs-571222, rs-571223, rs-571213, rs-981367, rs-907250, rs-960952, au-2ct-oval, au-1ct-emerald, au-3ct-round, au-cigar, au-xring, rs-997811, rs-939479, ag-14k-radiant-3ct, ag-14k-marquise-melted, ag-14k-leaves, ag-14k-petal, ag-14k-kite, ag-14k-cluster, ag-14k-bubble, rs-222283, rs-989853, rs-997441, ag-14k-industrial-band
items.finding: Ross-Simons ("All weights and measurements are approximate"), Automic Gold ("Approximate Gold Weight" / "Approximately X.Xg (gold)"), and Aurate publish approximate model weights rather than certified per-ring scale weights (and Auvere's "Approximate Fine Weight" size ranges are kept null due to alloy-vs-fine ambiguity — Flag F54). Verify delivered gram weight on a calibrated 0.01 g scale inside the return window.
items.buyer_action: Use the melt multiple as an order-of-magnitude check, not to the cent. Have the ring weighed on a jeweller's scale on arrival.

items.title: Mejuri's solid white gold is rhodium-plated on the surface — yellow gold is not
items.affected: Mejuri white-gold variants of the listed rows (the rows themselves are yellow gold)
items.finding: The Mejuri materials panel says: "14k solid white gold pieces are finished with rhodium plating, giving them their signature color along with added shine and durability." That is a surface finish on a solid 14k white gold ring, not a gold substitute — but a buyer filtering for "no plating" should know the white version carries a plating layer that wears over time and is re-polished by jewellers.
items.buyer_action: If plating is a hard no, choose the yellow or rose variants; if you want white, ask the jeweller about re-rhodium cost and interval.

items.title: One stored product title was a paraphrase, not the seller's string
items.finding: The dataset called Ross-Simons SKU 999230 "Pink Sapphire and Garnet Eternity Band in 14kt Yellow Gold". The seller's own title is ".80 ct. t.w. Garnet and .30 ct. t.w. Pink Sapphire Geometric Eternity Band in 14kt Yellow Gold". The paraphrase was replaced with the exact string on the P12 second read; the price (489.00-559.00) did not change.
items.buyer_action: Nothing at checkout. It is recorded because a paraphrased title is the first step towards a paraphrased specification, and this project claims to copy rather than summarise.

items.title: Anna Sheffield Bea solitaire no longer publishes a price
items.finding: The official product page still resolves and still describes the 1.50ct oval champagne diamond in 14k recycled gold, but it no longer displays any price: the buy box has been replaced by an enquiry form ('While this one-of-a-kind piece was made for a client, we are able to create a unique version just for you within your desired price range.'). The stored 11,500.00 could not be reproduced, so it is published as unverified and must not be used as a quote until Anna Sheffield prices the piece in writing.
items.buyer_action: Do not treat the stored 11,500.00 as a price. The row now reads '— unverified' on this site. Email Anna Sheffield for a written quote for a 1.50ct oval champagne diamond Bea solitaire in 14k, and ask for the metal weight in grams at the same time.

items.title: Two Blue Nile setting pages contradict themselves on karat and metal colour
items.finding: The page title/price block for Classic Comfort Fit (2.5mm) is headed '14K Yellow Gold' while the details panel on the same page reads '18k' and 'Metal: 18k Yellow Gold'. The Petite Nouveau six-prong page is headed '18K Yellow Gold' while its details panel reads 'polished 14k white gold'. Both rows store the karat from the page heading, which is what the price block is attached to; the contradiction is on the seller's own page and cannot be resolved from it.
items.buyer_action: Put the exact configuration in the basket and read the karat off the order summary before paying. Screenshot it. Karat is the single biggest driver of the gold value of the ring, so a 14K part billed as 18K is worth challenging.

items.title: Aurate Modern Cigar Band: the 14K variant price was not re-read at variant level
items.finding: Product, tags and the published 2.6-4g weight range were re-confirmed. The stored 1,308.00 belongs to the 14K/yellow/size-3 variant and was not re-readable at variant level this pass (the feed exposes only price_min 118.00 and price_max 1,668.00 for the product).
items.buyer_action: Select the 14K/yellow/size 3 variant and read the price in the basket before relying on the stored 1,308.00. The same product also sells a vermeil variant, so check which one is selected.

items.title: One stored price range could not be reproduced in full (rs-999230)
items.finding: This pass read a single clearance price of 489.00 at 23:48Z and could not reproduce the stored upper figure 559.00. P12 had recorded 489.00-559.00 at 23:35Z. The stored range is kept (both passes are published) and flagged rather than overwritten.
items.buyer_action: Read the price off the Ross-Simons page yourself before ordering. The clearance banner was live on 2026-10-22 and clearance stock is one-of-a-kind, so the price may move again without notice.

items.title: Aurate Diamond X Ring: the product feed shows a price band the row cannot attribute to one variant
items.finding: This pass read the storefront feed showing a product price band of 1,808.00-2,578.00 across variants, but the band could not be attributed to a specific metal/size variant on this read. The stored 1,808.00 (14K) is kept and the row is marked partially verified rather than widened to a range no single official line supports.
items.buyer_action: Choose your metal and size and read the price on the product page. If it is above the stored 1,808.00, the higher figure is the one that applies to the variant you picked.

items.title: Blue Nile 14K comfort-fit solitaire ($935) says "18k yellow gold" in prose and misses $1,000 warranty floor
items.finding: On item 203284 (Stock 501146y14), the title and Metal specification state "14K Yellow Gold" at "$935 (Setting Price)", but the Product Details paragraph on the same page states "crafted in 18k yellow gold". On the same page, Blue Nile's Limited Lifetime Warranty states: "We warrant all gold and platinum jewelry items with a purchase price of $1,000 or more from manufacturer's defect" — leaving a standalone $935 setting below that stated $1,000 threshold.
items.buyer_action: Get written confirmation of 14K vs 18K alloy and confirm whether warranty coverage applies when the setting is purchased below $1,000.

items.title: Mejuri labels hollowed rings "solid gold" — directly conflicting with FTC 16 CFR § 23.3(c)(1)
items.affected: Mejuri catalog & FAQ (e.g. bold-chain-ring; verify non-hollow construction on mej-2mm, mej-db, mej-deb, mej-bde, mej-10k-dlr, mej-10k-sig)
items.finding: Under eCFR 16 CFR § 23.3(c)(1) (current 2026-10-21), FTC Jewelry Guides state it is unfair or deceptive to mark, describe, or otherwise represent any karat gold item with a hollow center as "Solid Gold". Yet Mejuri's official FAQ states hollow-form pieces are "still considered solid gold", and Mejuri's live Bold Chain Ring page ($348) simultaneously lists "Material: 10k Yellow Gold", "Specifications: Hollowed 14K gold" (a 10K vs 14K internal contradiction), and image alt text "handcrafted in hollowed 14k solid gold".
items.buyer_action: Ask any seller in writing whether a ring is solid throughout (non-hollow, non-electroformed) — not merely unplated — and verify expected mass by gram weight and specific gravity.

items.title: Two Anna Sheffield listings have no live HTML price or Add-to-Bag button (custom client archive pages)
items.finding: Opening the live HTML pages for as-bea-sol ($11,500.00 in feed) and as-hazeline ($7,150.00–$9,200.00 in feed) reveals no visible retail price and no checkout button; instead both display a custom inquiry form stating: "While this one-of-a-kind piece was made for a client, we are able to create a unique version just for you within your desired price range." Their recorded prices exist only in Shopify's underlying product JSON feed for previously sold pieces, whereas as-bea-3stone ($5,400.00–$25,100.00) has a live Add-to-Bag button.
items.buyer_action: Treat as-bea-sol and as-hazeline prices as historical archive figures; request a current written quote and return eligibility before commissioning a custom build (custom Anna Sheffield orders are final sale).

items.title: Aurate New York holds a BBB "F" rating and displays "Final Sale! Exchange for size only" on all 5 ring PDPs

items.title: Aurate's published "Weight" on diamond rings includes stone mass (~0.09–0.57 g), unlike Ross-Simons "Gold Weight"
items.affected: au-2ct-oval (2.73 g, 2.25 tcw), au-1ct-emerald (1.97 g, 0.85 tcw), au-3ct-round (3.3 g, 2.85 tcw), au-xring (2.7 g, 0.44 tcw)

Unlike Ross-Simons ("Gold Weight") and Automic Gold ("Approximately X.Xg (gold)"), Aurate labels the field simply "Weight:", which for stone-set rings can include diamond mass (under 16 CFR § 23.18, 1 metric carat = 0.200 g, so a 2.85 tcw diamond weighs 0.57 g).
items.buyer_action: When using the Gold Calculator on stone-set rings whose seller states total item weight rather than gold-only weight, subtract 0.20 g per carat of stones.

items.title: With Clarity caps returns at 1 per 6 months and labels white-gold gallery views "14KT Platinum"

In addition, live HTML gallery alt text on wc-tulip, wc-6prong, and wc-gerbera labels white-metal views "in 14KT Platinum" (platinum is 950/900 fine, never 14KT). Similarly, Blue Nile caps free US returns at 2 per year and starts its 30-day clock at shipment rather than delivery, while Brilliant Earth starts its 30-day clock when the order is available for shipment/pickup.
items.buyer_action: Check comparative-purchasing and return-frequency caps before ordering multiple rings, and verify 14K White Gold vs 950 Platinum in the written order summary.

items.title: Surface XRF alone can be fooled by electroformed resin cores and "gold-plated gold" (GIA Lab Notes 2024–2025)
items.finding: GIA Gems & Gemology Lab Notes document two critical failure modes of standalone XRF testing because X-ray fluorescence reads only a shallow surface layer (microns): (1) Spring 2024 (Vol. 60, No. 1): a 41 g electroformed gold-plated resin bracelet with a glued-on 14K stamped disk read 17.99K–22.47K on XRF with no plating alert; (2) Summer 2025 (Vol. 61, No. 2, "Gold-Plated Gold"): 9K and 10K rings/chains plated with higher-karat yellow gold read 13.5K–18K on XRF without triggering a plating warning.
items.buyer_action: Ask your independent jeweller/appraiser to pair XRF with precision gram weighing + hydrostatic specific-gravity (density) testing and microscopic inspection inside the return window.

items.title: Menē 24K pure-gold bands omit static HTML gram numbers and carry ±1 g Crafted-on-Demand weight variance + 10% refund restocking fee

Under the zero-hallucination rule, gram weight is left blank rather than back-calculated from spot. Menē's Terms of Service (effective Sep 2, 2026) also state Crafted-on-Demand weights may vary by ±1.0 g (final weight printed on the Certificate of Authenticity), discretionary returns must be initiated within 7 days of receipt, original-payment refunds may deduct up to a 10% restocking fee (100% value for Menē Credit), and missing the Certificate of Authenticity triggers a 5% assessment fee.
items.buyer_action: Read the exact gram weight from the live Price Breakdown before checkout, verify it against the Certificate of Authenticity and a jeweller's scale within 7 days of delivery, and note the 10% cash-refund restocking fee.

items.title: Auvere 22K PDPs label size-dependent gram ranges "Approximate Fine Weight" — kept blank rather than guessed
items.finding: Auvere closes the 22K (91.7% gold) tier with explicit "Handcrafted from solid 22 karat gold" disclosures, and its live PDPs print gram ranges by ring size ("Approximate Fine Weight: 2.9 to 3.7 grams depending on size" on V Neck Small; "3.3 to 3.5 grams" on Hexagon Diamond; "5 to 6.1 grams" on Diamond Bridge Tall; "2.8 to 3.7 grams" on Clean Cut Polished). However, whereas older search-indexed snippets read "Approximate Gold Weight", Auvere's live PDP template labels the field "Approximate Fine Weight". In precious-metals terminology, "fine weight" means 24K pure gold content while "gold weight" means 22K alloy mass — an 8.3% difference. Under our No-Hallucinations rule, weight_g_low/weight_g_high are kept null so the calculator never guesses which basis Auvere intended.
items.buyer_action: Ask concierge@auvere.com (1-866-317-7779) in writing before checkout whether the quoted grams represent gross 22K alloy weight or net 24K fine-gold content for your exact ring size, and weigh on a calibrated 0.01 g scale upon delivery.

items.title: Site defect found & fixed: partly-verified and withdrawn rows displayed a green "confirmed" status chip
items.affected: as-bea-sol, as-hazeline, as-bea-3stone, au-cigar, rs-939479, bn-14k-petite-195639
items.finding: Found by sess-0a6df02e on 2026-10-23 during the ninth-pass line-by-line review. scripts/build.mjs compared each row's verification_status against the string "partially verified", but the dataset's value is "partly_verified" — the comparison never matched, so the 4 partly_verified rows and the withdrawn rs-939479 rendered a green "confirmed" chip in tables and "confirmed on the official page" on their detail pages. The prices themselves were always rendered correctly: unverified prices printed "— unverified" throughout (enforced by verify.mjs S19), and no stored value was wrong — only the status label overstated the verification state. Fixed in this pass: both chip sites now test the real status values (withdrawn renders "withdrawn — source changed"), and verify.mjs S18 gained a regression assertion that fails the run if a partly_verified or withdrawn detail page ever claims "confirmed on the official page" again. Published here, after the fix, so the inaccuracy is on the record rather than silently patched. (Renumbered F60→F66 at the T46 union merges; see F65 note.)
items.buyer_action: No purchase decision changes: the affected rows' prices, evidence quotes and unverified markings were correct the whole time. If you read the site before this fix and saw a green "confirmed" chip on an Anna Sheffield, Aurate cigar-band or Ross-Simons 939479 page, re-open that row — it now shows its true partly-verified/withdrawn state.
